name: qkd_seq_xs_s

pin_regs.reason: x_v / x_d / qpop land in pin flops (xv / xd / qp) and q_w / q_e are the registered copies, as qkd_seq_xs_tp8; a recipe-3 pin register would add an edge to the compiled Q push/pop.

structural_change: Successor of qkd_seq_xs_tp8 (x4): Q FIFO 40 x 128 + two registered copies only; KVN FIFO (8 x 128), eight KVN word registers and the 2 x 256-b row copies deleted (kvn face has no consumer). 131 N / 128 W / 128 E pins. Outline sized to util 0.52 from the gate-measured std area (~4,310 um2: the 40 x 128 Q FIFO is flops + read mux; 64.8 x 64.8 gave GPL-0301 117.7 %).

job.purpose: RTL-BUILD-KV/SEQ 10-18 (P3): successor cluster qkd_seq_static_s of qkd_seq_static_p WITHOUT the legacy landing faces (kvn_<q>_d out has no consumer, kvn_<q>_cr / mf_<q> in have no producer on the static KV die): logic deleted (row-credit account, posted-row timeline, KVN store, kvn pin stages, xd_sel). Bench: LOCKSTEP vs qkd_seq_static_p (always-available credit, mf 0) with the actual attention programme RTL, aq/kc/hs/tk/kst compared on every edge over 36 link-slotted layers plus a live fault phase.

benches.name: seq_s_pass
